spot: LONG only, no leverage, no shorts, no pyramiding
warmup: All rows before the requested period are warmup only; signals require 20 complete prior days and ATR20 including the current complete day; no July-December 2025 data
signal: D1 UTC; U=max high previous 20 complete days; D=min low previous 10 complete days; ATR=SMA20 TR including current day; B=close>U; entry only B false to true
entry: P=00:00 close, V=00:00 base volume, execute 00:01 open with a
